slug:api-bank.name: API-Bank
slug:api-bank.description: A benchmark of dialog traces with tool-call annotations across three complexity levels for evaluating LLM tool-use / API-calling ability.
slug:api-bank.size: ~95 MB (train/test splits across level 1-3 API and response files)

slug:bfcl.name: Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard (BFCL)
slug:bfcl.provider: UC Berkeley Gorilla LLM project (Sky Computing Lab)
slug:bfcl.description: A live leaderboard/benchmark dataset evaluating LLMs' ability to call functions/tools across simple, parallel, multiple, multi-turn and multi-language (Java, JavaScript, REST, SQL) scenarios.
slug:bfcl.size: 27 dataset files spanning simple/parallel/multi-turn/live function-calling categories

slug:gorilla-api-bench.name: APIBench (Gorilla)
slug:gorilla-api-bench.provider: UC Berkeley (Shishir G. Patil, Tianjun Zhang, Xin Wang, Joseph E. Gonzalez - Gorilla project)
slug:gorilla-api-bench.description: Training/evaluation data of 1,600+ API calls (HuggingFace, TensorFlow Hub, TorchHub) used to benchmark LLMs invoking APIs accurately while minimizing hallucination.

slug:nexus.name: Nexus Function Calling Benchmark (NexusRaven API evaluation)
slug:nexus.description: Evaluation dataset used for the NexusRaven function-calling benchmark, combining Nexusflow-curated real-world API queries (CVE/CPE, VirusTotal, etc.) with general-domain ToolLLM/ToolAlpaca samples.
slug:nexus.size: 348 examples (outputs_in_toolllm_format), plus raw/standardized API list and query configs (65 APIs, 318-339 queries)

reference.title: nexusflowai/NexusRaven (evaluation code and data license notes)

slug:or-bench-80k.name: OR-Bench-80K
slug:or-bench-80k.description: 80,000 seemingly-toxic but actually benign prompts across 10 common rejection categories, used to measure LLM over-refusal behavior; part of the larger OR-Bench collection (also includes OR-Bench-Hard-1K and OR-Bench-Toxic configs).

reference.title: OR-Bench: An Over-Refusal Benchmark for Large Language Models

slug:cleaned-alpaca.name: Alpaca-Cleaned
slug:cleaned-alpaca.provider: yahma (community curation of Stanford Alpaca data)
slug:cleaned-alpaca.description: A cleaned version of the original Stanford Alpaca instruction-following dataset, with hallucinations, merged instructions, and formatting errors fixed.
slug:cleaned-alpaca.size: ~51,760 instruction-input-output examples (10K-100K range per dataset card)

slug:synthetic_alpaca.name: Synthetic Alpaca DPO preference data (Meta SecAlign)
slug:synthetic_alpaca.description: Not a standalone released dataset: a DPO preference dataset locally generated by the Meta_SecAlign training pipeline (generate_preference_dataset in utils.py) by injecting prompts into yahma/alpaca-cleaned instructions and pairing self-generated ('synthetic') vs. injected responses; file name pattern preference_<model>_dpo_NaiveCompletion_synthetic_alpaca.json.
